column11: BaxPA (NCT07007793) enrols adults with primary aldosteronism by the 2016 or 2025 Endocrine Society criteria who have 'a stable regimen of antihypertensive medications for at least 4 weeks prior to randomisation' and a 'mean seated SBP on AOBPM of >= 135 mmHg and <= 170 mmHg', which is the population the current label already covers: 'in combination with other antihypertensive drugs ... in adults who are not adequately controlled on other agents' (DailyMed setid b1fc1ee7-facc-4099-b3db-a4c1daeaa4be, effective 18 September 2026). A systolic pressure of 135 or more on treatment is above the below-130/80 mmHg goal of the 2017 ACC/AHA guideline (Whelton PK et al., Hypertension 2018;71:e13-e115), the guideline the label itself points to
